author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.3 - Fixes a Set Fan Run Time side effect from 0.19.2: if you already had a hold running when a timed fan run started, ending the run would clear that hold too. Now the timed run only returns to the schedule if it created the hold itself — a run started while a hold is already active just switches the fan back to Auto and leaves your hold in place. (0.19.2 made timed fan runs clean up the hold that turning the fan On creates; 0.19.1 added human-readable timeSinceMotion/timeSinceOccupancy on remote sensors.)
tags: Thermostat, ecobee, HomeKit, HAP, Local, Sensor
